notes: Both kernels combined; random rotated-basis inputs; c0 covariates; warm-up + 3-trial mean. Python path uses nested torch.linalg.solve over per-pair Xy. Native path precomputes weighted cross-products via torch BLAS once per block, then inline Cholesky + solve + SSR per pair. OpenMP across the outer SNP loop.
scaling: Native time scales sub-linearly with s_b*f_b because the small (p_y x p_y) Cholesky per pair is cache-resident; the precomputed cross-products amortize across all f_b mediators within a single SNP iteration.
